process_area.title: Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics

value_stream.name: Performance Bond, Surety & Bank Guarantee Management

fields.Participants: Surety Program Manager, Sales (links to VS-46/VS-11), Legal (links to VS-100.3), PMO (links to VS-112), Surety/Bank, Finance (links to VS-17), Warranty Mgmt (links to VS-53)
fields.Trigger: Contract completion/milestone; warranty expiry; bond expiry (links to W3654)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "verify the release conditions in the contract/bond and obtain the beneficiary…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-request of "request the surety/bank to release/cancel the bond and return the…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Surety Program Manager/Finance update the encumbrance register" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-579 (ensure controlled execution — Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics (PA-116.3).)
- operational: release tracking and active closeout; operational: acceptance evidence and legal (W3660)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Trapped-capital risk**: Bonds not released after completion trap collateral/cash/credit; mitigated by release tracking and active closeout
- **Beneficiary-obstruction risk**: Beneficiary won't release without dispute; mitigated by acceptance evidence and legal (W3660)
System Touchpoints: - Contract/PMO (links to VS-46/VS-11/VS-112); warranty (links to VS-53); treasury/banking (links to VS-18.2); finance/accounting (links to VS-17); encumbrance register (links to W3654); records (links to W3648)

steps.activity: Surety Program Manager/PMO identify release-eligible bonds: contract/substantial-completion milestone, customer acceptance, warranty expiry, or bond expiry; verify the release conditions in the contract/bond and obtain the beneficiary release/clearance

Surety Program Manager/Treasury execute the release: request the surety/bank to release/cancel the bond and return the collateral/cash margin (W3644/W3653), release the credit-line encumbrance (links to VS-18.2), and confirm the closure in writing; manage beneficiary non-response/obstruction

Surety Program Manager/Finance update the encumbrance register (W3654) and records (W3648), release the restricted cash/collateral in accounting (links to VS-17), and report release cycle-time and trapped-bond risk to governance (W3661); drive release discipline to minimize trapped capital

fields.Participants: Surety Program Manager, Legal (links to VS-100), CFO/CEO, Treasury (links to VS-18), PMO (links to VS-112), B2G/B2B Sales (links to VS-46/VS-11), Surety/Bank, Risk (links to VS-21.2), Insurance (links to VS-26), Communications (links to VS-14.3)
fields.Trigger: Bond call/demand by beneficiary; alleged default; performance dispute

workflows.name: Bond Claim, Demand & Default Response Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Legal/Surety Program Manager respond to the demand" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Surety Program Manager/Legal manage the aftermath" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-579 (ensure controlled execution — Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics (PA-116.3).)
- operational: contest/legal response; operational: delivery and early dispute resolution
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wrongful-call risk**: Beneficiary calls the bond unfairly; mitigated by contest/legal response
- **Default-exposure risk**: Valid default exposes BuildRight to payment and reputational damage; mitigated by delivery and early dispute resolution
System Touchpoints: - Legal (links to VS-100); treasury/banking (links to VS-18); surety/bank; risk (links to VS-21.2); insurance (links to VS-26); governance (links to VS-36); records (links to W3648/W3661)

steps.activity: Surety Program Manager/Legal receive and triage the bond call/demand: the beneficiary's demand, the alleged default/breach, the bond/contract basis, the demand validity (compliance with bond terms), and the amount; immediate notification to CFO/CEO and the surety/bank; assess exposure

Legal/Surety Program Manager respond to the demand: where the demand is wrongful/invalid, contest it (injunction, legal notice); where valid, manage the resolution (cure the default, negotiate settlement, or accept the bond payment); engage the surety/bank on their obligations and coordinate the counter-indemnity (W3659)

Surety Program Manager/Legal manage the aftermath: bond payment and recovery/subrogation (W3659), dispute/litigation (W3660), insurance/recovery (links to VS-26), regulatory notification (government-beneficiary cases links to VS-22), communications (links to VS-14.3), and capture the claim record/lessons (W3648/W3661); report to the board (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Surety Program Manager, Legal (links to VS-100), Treasury (links to VS-18), Finance (links to VS-17), Surety/Bank, PMO (links to VS-112), Insurance (links to VS-26), Risk (links to VS-21.2)
fields.Trigger: Surety/bank pays a bond claim and calls BuildRight's counter-indemnity (W3658)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Surety Program Manager/Treasury/Legal manage the counter-indemnity call" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track recovery vs." (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-579 (ensure controlled execution — Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics (PA-116.3).)
- operational: recovery/subrogation and upstream risk transfer; operational: upstream security/insurance
Pain Points / Risks: - **Indemnity-loss risk**: BuildRight bears the bond payment unrecovered; mitigated by recovery/subrogation and upstream risk transfer
- **Recovery-failure risk**: Responsible party insolvent/unreachable; mitigated by upstream security/insurance
System Touchpoints: - Legal (links to VS-100); treasury/banking (links to VS-18); finance/accounting (links to VS-17); insurance (links to VS-26); risk (links to VS-21.2); governance (links to VS-36); records (links to W3648)

steps.activity: Surety Program Manager/Treasury/Legal manage the counter-indemnity call: the surety/bank's demand for indemnity after paying the bond, the indemnity amount (bond paid + surety costs/fees), and BuildRight's obligation under the GAI (W3644); assess the validity and amount

Treasury/Finance settle the indemnity obligation (cash/collateral call W3644, credit draw), account for the loss/recoverable (links to VS-17), and pursue recovery/subrogation: recover from the responsible party (subcontractor/defaulting JV partner), insurer (professional indemnity/contractor insurance links to VS-26), or via contract remedies

Legal/Surety Program Manager manage subrogation and recovery actions (links to VS-100 litigation), track recovery vs. loss, and feed lessons to underwriting/contract-risk (W3646) and provider management (W3643); report indemnity-call exposure to governance (W3661) and the board (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Legal (links to VS-100), Surety Program Manager, CFO/CEO, Treasury (links to VS-18), PMO (links to VS-112), Outside Counsel, Risk (links to VS-21.2), Insurance (links to VS-26)
fields.Trigger: Bond dispute (wrongful call, default allegation, release obstruction); unresolved claim

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "counter-party's position, and the remedies" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report material disputes to the board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-579 (ensure controlled execution — Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics (PA-116.3).)
- operational: ADR and early resolution; operational: loss-contingency accounting and risk transfer
Pain Points / Risks: - **Protracted-litigation risk**: Dispute drags, locking capital and management attention; mitigated by ADR and early resolution
- **Loss-contingency risk**: Adverse outcome creates material loss; mitigated by loss-contingency accounting and risk transfer
System Touchpoints: - Legal/litigation (links to VS-100); finance/contingency (links to VS-17); treasury (links to VS-18); risk (links to VS-21.2); governance (links to VS-36); records (links to W3648)

steps.activity: Legal/Surety Program Manager assess the dispute: the bond/contract/legal basis, BuildRight's position, evidence (delivery/performance/compliance), the counter-party's position, and the remedies (negotiation, mediation, arbitration, litigation); assess loss contingency (links to VS-17/VS-100)
steps.r: Legal / Surety Program Manager / Outside Counsel

steps.activity: Legal manage the dispute resolution: negotiation/mediation first, arbitration (common in B2B/construction) or litigation (Regional Trial Court / Court of Appeals / Supreme Court, or government-administrative bodies for B2G), injunction against wrongful bond call, and outside-counsel engagement (links to VS-100.3)

Legal/Surety Program Manager manage the outcome and settlement, account for the loss/recovery (links to VS-17), capture lessons (W3648/W3661), and feed prevention to contract-risk/underwriting (W3646) and contract terms (links to VS-46/VS-11); report material disputes to the board (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Surety Program Manager, Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4), Treasury (links to VS-18), BI (links to VS-28.1), ExCo (links to VS-33.2), Risk (links to VS-21.2)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-allocate of "allocate to entity/contract" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "analyze cost drivers and optimization" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track over time" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-579 (ensure controlled execution — Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics (PA-116.3).)
- operational: cost capture and allocation; operational: encumbrance/release analytics
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-opacity risk**: Surety cost scattered and unmanaged; mitigated by cost capture and allocation
- **Trapped-capital-invisibility risk**: Unreleased bonds silently trap capital; mitigated by encumbrance/release analytics
System Touchpoints: - Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4); treasury/banking (links to VS-18.2); BI (links to VS-28.1); encumbrance register (links to W3654); risk (links to VS-21.2); analytics

steps.activity: Surety Program Manager/Finance capture surety spend and encumbrance: premiums/fees by instrument/provider/contract, collateral/cash margin tied up, credit-line encumbrance (links to VS-18.2), claim/loss cost (W3658/W3659), and release-cycle trapped capital; allocate to entity/contract

Surety Program Manager/Finance analyze cost drivers and optimization: instrument mix (W3645), provider pricing, collateral vs. bond substitution, trapped-capital cost, and claim-loss trend; identify savings and risk-concentration

Surety Program Manager publish surety spend, encumbrance, and exposure analytics to ExCo (links to VS-33.2) and the risk committee (links to VS-21.2/VS-36), drive cost/risk optimization, and track over time; feed to facility strategy (W3642) and instrument-mix (W3641)

fields.Participants: Surety Program Manager, Treasury (links to VS-18), Procurement (links to VS-34), Finance (links to VS-17), Legal (links to VS-100.3), BI (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Trigger: Provider review cycle; renewal; performance issue

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Surety Program Manager/Treasury define and instrument provider KPIs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Surety Program Manager/Treasury conduct periodic provider reviews" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "Surety Program Manager manage provider performance issues and exit/replacement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-579 (ensure controlled execution — Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics (PA-116.3).)
- operational: turnaround KPI and diversification; operational: scorecard-driven diversification
Pain Points / Risks: - **Poor-turnaround risk**: Slow provider causes missed bid deadline; mitigated by turnaround KPI and diversification
- **Concentration risk**: Over-reliance on a weak provider; mitigated by scorecard-driven diversification
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/banking (links to VS-18); procurement/vendor (links to VS-34/VS-67); finance (links to VS-17); BI (links to VS-28.1); analytics (links to W3661)

steps.activity: Surety Program Manager/Treasury define and instrument provider KPIs: turnaround (application to issuance), pricing (W3645), claim handling (W3658), capacity/flexibility, financial strength, and service quality; integrate to the vendor scorecard methodology (links to VS-67)

Surety Program Manager/Treasury conduct periodic provider reviews: scorecard review with each surety/bank, performance feedback, volume/share discussion, pricing negotiation (W3645), and improvement actions; manage the provider portfolio and diversification

Surety Program Manager manage provider performance issues and exit/replacement, feed to the approved-provider list (W3643), and report provider performance to governance (W3661) and procurement (links to VS-34)

fields.Participants: Surety Program Manager, PMO (links to VS-112), B2G/B2B Sales (links to VS-46/VS-11), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Quality (links to VS-31), BI (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Trigger: Monthly/quarterly analytics; PMO delivery review (links to VS-112)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "Surety Program Manager/PMO track bond-backed contract delivery performance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "analyze the bond-claim/default drivers" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report contract/bond compliance and delivery performance to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-579 (ensure controlled execution — Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics (PA-116.3).)
- operational: performance tracking and early intervention; operational: driver analysis and go/no-go discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **At-risk-contract risk**: Delivery slippage on a bond-backed contract risks claim; mitigated by performance tracking and early intervention
- **Systemic risk**: Recurring default pattern in a contract type/customer; mitigated by driver analysis and go/no-go discipline
System Touchpoints: - PMO delivery (links to VS-112); sales/contract (links to VS-46/VS-11); warranty (links to VS-53); finance (links to VS-17.4); legal (links to VS-100.3); risk (links to VS-21.2); analytics (links to W3661)

steps.activity: Surety Program Manager/PMO track bond-backed contract delivery performance: milestone delivery vs. plan, quality/acceptance, default-risk indicators, warranty performance (links to VS-53), and the bond-utilization profile; identify at-risk contracts (default/claim exposure)

Surety Program Manager/PMO analyze the bond-claim/default drivers: contract type, customer (government vs. private), project complexity, delivery issues, and external factors; identify systemic risk and feed to contract-risk assessment (W3646) and go/no-go (links to VS-46)
steps.r: Surety Program Manager / PMO / Legal / BI

steps.activity: Surety Program Manager report contract/bond compliance and delivery performance to governance (W3661), the risk committee (links to VS-21.2), and ExCo (links to VS-33.2); drive corrective action on at-risk contracts and prevention on future bids

fields.Participants: Surety Program Manager, Audit (links to VS-21), Treasury (links to VS-18), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Risk (links to VS-21.2), ExCo (links to VS-33.2), Innovation/IT (links to VS-30/VS-27)
fields.Trigger: Annual cycle; strategy refresh (W3641); audit; opportunity

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Surety Program Manager/Audit assess surety-program maturity" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "tracking, integration to contract/PMO systems, predictive claim-risk, and…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report program maturity, improvement progress, and value to ExCo" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-579 (ensure controlled execution — Bond Release, Claims, Recovery & Surety Analytics (PA-116.3).)
- operational: digital platforms and automation; operational: independent audit input
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stagnation risk**: Program never advances beyond manual/ad-hoc; mitigated by digital platforms and automation
- **Self-assessment bias risk**: Maturity overstated; mitigated by independent audit input
System Touchpoints: - Audit (links to VS-21); innovation/IT (links to VS-30/VS-27); PMO (links to VS-112); risk (links to VS-21.2); governance (links to VS-36); analytics (links to W3661); strategy (links to W3641)

steps.activity: Surety Program Manager/Audit assess surety-program maturity: governance (W3641), facility/provider management (W3642/W3643), encumbrance accuracy (W3654), release discipline (W3657), cost optimization (W3645), claim handling (W3658), records (W3648), and analytics maturity (W3661); benchmark to good practice

Surety Program Manager identify improvements and innovation: digital bond platforms (e-surety / PhilGEPS electronic bid security), automation of encumbrance/release tracking, integration to contract/PMO systems, predictive claim-risk, and instrument-mix optimization; prioritize and resource via the PMO (links to VS-112)

Surety Program Manager report program maturity, improvement progress, and value to ExCo (links to VS-33.2) and the board/risk committee (links to VS-36), and feed learnings to strategy (W3641), facility (W3642), and policy (W3647); drive continuous improvement
